title: Brew unit fault
shortDescription: Brew unit motor or position sensor fault.
fullDescription:
Miele CM5 and CM6 coffee makers report F1 when the brew unit fails to reach home position within timeout. Compacted grounds or worn drive gears are common causes.

Clean the brew unit and lubricate the rails with Miele-approved grease.

fixSteps.title: Clean and lube
fixSteps.instruction: Remove brew unit, rinse, lubricate rails.

faq.a: Yes, brew unit is user-serviceable on most models.

title: Heating element fault
shortDescription: Boiler did not reach brew temperature.
fullDescription:
F2 indicates the heating element or its NTC sensor has failed. Without verified temperature, brewing is locked out.

Professional service usually required.

title: Pump pressure fault
fullDescription:
F3 indicates the vibration pump did not reach pressure within the expected window. Air locks, scale, or a failed pump are likely causes.

Descale first, then run prime cycle.

fixSteps.title: Descale
fixSteps.instruction: Run descaling cycle with Miele descaler.

title: Grinder jam
fullDescription:
F4 indicates excess current draw on the grinder, suggesting a foreign object or compacted oily beans.

Vacuum the burrs and use only roasted dry beans.

fixSteps.title: Clear burrs
fixSteps.instruction: Remove top burr per manual; vacuum chamber.

title: Water tank fault
fullDescription:
F5 indicates the water tank position or float sensor is reporting an invalid state. Reseat the tank firmly; clean the magnetic float.

Sensor cleaning resolves most cases.

title: Steam circuit fault
fullDescription:
F10 indicates the steam circuit pressure or temperature is out of bounds. Dried milk in the wand is the typical cause.

Clean wand thoroughly and run system clean cycle.

title: Drip tray full
fullDescription:
F73 indicates the drip tray is full or not seated. Empty and dry the contacts.

Magnetic float corrosion can cause persistent F73.

title: Coffee grounds container
fullDescription:
F76 indicates the puck container is full or not detected. Empty and reseat.

Magnetic seat detection requires container in correct orientation.

title: Communication fault
fullDescription:
F227 indicates a communication failure between the main controller and a peripheral board. Cycling power often clears it; persistent F227 requires service.

Document conditions for the technician.

title: Descaling required
fullDescription:
The machine prompts a descaling cycle based on water hardness and runtime. Failure to descale leads to F3 or F2 faults.

Use Miele-approved descaler only.
